title: Hearing on seaplanes, party boats and ferry service
summary: A joint Council hearing examining safety and oversight of seaplanes, excursion "party boats" and NYC Ferry, alongside four bills to create ferry service at Canarsie Pier, Willets Point, West 125th Street and City Island. The hearing reviews recent safety incidents, including a fatal 2026 capsizing near Liberty Island and a 2025 explosion off City Island, and scrutinizes NYC Ferry's cost, subsidies and a fare increase to $5.00 effective October 19, 2026.
